name: One With the Snow
source:
You and another person are the last two people alive in your country - and your goal is to contact other survivors. 

...but, can you two even survive long enough?

[From [url=https://komarux.itch.io/one-with-the-snow]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你和另一个人是你所在国家仅存的两个人 - 你的目标是联系其他幸存者。

……但是，你们两个还能活得够久吗？

[来自[url=https://komarux.itch.io/one-with-the-snow]Itch.io[/url]]
